title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. translated_title: S-Space：探索多模态语言模型中的空间工作空间
translated_abstract: 多模态语言模型（MLLMs）展现出有前景的空间推理能力，然而支持这些能力的内部机制仍然知之甚少。我们发现了S-Space——一个线性表示子空间，其中物体标记的表示沿着水平、垂直和距离三个轴编码连续坐标。尽管我们通过对物体标记激活求空间答案得分的梯度来识别这些轴，但S-Space是模型内在的，而非由特定数据或提示诱导产生，在非空间问题下依然保持可读性。我们证明S-Space充当着多模态语言模型的内部空间工作空间：感知过程将物体位置编码到其中，形成可直接读取以支持准确空间判断的空间表示；内部推理过程对其进行变换以实现视角转换；言语响应则选择性地访问它——因果干预实验证实了这一点，干预会改变空间判断，同时（在很大程度上不影响其他能力）。
tldr: 该论文发现多模态语言模型内部存在一个固有的线性子空间"S-Space"，作为模型的内部空间工作空间，以连续坐标编码物体位置，并支撑感知编码、视角变换和言语输出等空间推理的全过程。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers "S-Space", an intrinsic linear representation subspace in multimodal language models that functions as an internal spatial workspace, encoding object locations as continuous coordinates and supporting perception encoding, viewpoint transformation, and selective verbal access, as evidenced by causal interventions.
